topic: Asking the International Office about a Work Permit Renewal

script.title: RENEWING MY WORK PERMIT
script.scene_zh: 國際學生辦公室 · 續辦許可
script.story_hook: Her work permit is ending, and questions pile up.
script.intro_zh: 工作許可快到期，問題一個接著一個冒出來。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to the international office. Listen for renewal questions.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到國際學生辦公室。留意續辦相關的問句。
script.outro: And the renewal feels doable now. Listen again and plan along.
script.outro_zh: 續辦這件事現在感覺可行了。再聽一次，跟著一起計畫。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a young East Asian woman in her early twenties with long straight black hair in a low side braid, thin rimless glasses, a burgundy sweater, a lanyard with a student ID, and a small frame
script.char_b_description: a Black man in his forties with a close shaved head, a neat short beard, square glasses, a warm yellow sweater under a tan blazer, dark chinos, and a solid build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, thanks for seeing me on such short notice.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ θæŋks fɚ ˈsizɪŋ mi ɑn sʌʃ ʃɔɹt ˈnoʊtɪs/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，謝謝你這麼快就抽空見我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, grab a seat, what's going on?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs ɡɹæb ə sit wʌts ɡoʊɪŋ ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 別客氣，先坐下，發生什麼事了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My work permit expires soon, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ wɝk pɚˈmit ɪkˈspaɪɹz sun aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 我想我的工作許可快要到期了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, let's check the date first together.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ lɛts tʃɛk ðə deɪt fɝst təˈɡɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好，我們先一起看一下到期日。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It ends in late October, I believe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɛndz ɪn leɪt ɑkˈtoʊbɚ aɪ bɪˈliv/
dialogue.zh: 應該是在十月下旬到期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good news, you're right inside the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd nuz jʊɹ raɪt ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好消息，你正好在可辦理的期間內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Window? I thought we could file anytime.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪndoʊ aɪ θɑːt wi kʊd faɪl ˈɛniˌtaɪm/
dialogue.zh: 期間？我以為隨時都能申請。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it opens ninety days before expiry.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪt ˈoʊpənz ˈnaɪnti deɪz bɪˈfɔɹ ɪkˈspɪɹi/
dialogue.zh: 不是，要在到期前九十天才開放。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ninety days? So I should hurry, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪnti deɪz soʊ aɪ ʃʊd ˈhɝi ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 九十天前？那我得抓緊時間了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're actually early, which is a relief.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈæktʃuəli ˈɜɹli wɪtʃ ɪz ə ɹɪˈlif/
dialogue.zh: 你其實還算早，這樣我就放心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So what do I need to bring along?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌt du aɪ nid tə bɹɪŋ əˈlɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那我得帶哪些東西過來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The form, your old card, and photos.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɔɹm jɔɹ oʊld kɑɹd ænd ˈfoʊtoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 表格、你的舊卡，還有幾張照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Photos? How many, and what size exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtoʊz haʊ ˈmɛni ænd wʌt saɪz ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 照片？要幾張，尺寸到底是多大？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two, passport style, white background, recent.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈpæspɔɹt staɪl waɪt ˈbækˌɡɹaʊnd ˈɹisənt/
dialogue.zh: 兩張，護照規格，白底，最近的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, can I use my phone picture?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm kən aɪ juz maɪ foʊn ˈpɪktʃɚ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我可以用手機拍的那張嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better not, they reject phone selfies often.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛɾɚ nɑt ðeɹ ɹɪˈdʒɛkt foʊn ˈsɛlˌfiz ˈɔfən/
dialogue.zh: 最好別，手機自拍常常不合格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, I already took one at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ aɪ ɔːlˈɹɛdi tʊk wʌn æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，我在家已經自拍一張了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries, there's a booth in the library.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɝiz ðɛɹz ə buθ ɪn ðə ˈlaɪˌbɛɹi/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，圖書館裡有拍照機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, is the background right there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ɪz ðə ˈbækˌɡɹaʊnd raɪt ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那邊的背景是白底的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, white, and take off your glasses.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs waɪt ænd teɪk ɔf jɔɹ ˈɡlæsɪz/
dialogue.zh: 對，白底，而且要摘眼鏡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glasses off, got it, good to know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡlæsɪz ɔf ɡɑt ɪt ɡʊd tə noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 要摘眼鏡，記下了，幸好問了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more thing, when did you last travel?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ wɛn dɪd ju læst ˈtɹævəl/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，你上次出境是什麼時候？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Over summer, I visited home for a month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊvɚ ˈsʌmɚ aɪ ˈvɪzɪtd hoʊm fɔɹ ə mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 暑假時，我回國住了大約一個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then check your travel signature, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tʃɛk jɔɹ ˈtɹævəl ˈsɪɡnətʃɚ pliz/
dialogue.zh: 那請你確認一下你的出境簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Travel signature? Is that on my form?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɹævəl ˈsɪɡnətʃɚ ɪz ðæt ɑn maɪ fɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 出境簽名？是寫在我的表格上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's on page two, signed by an advisor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɑn peɪdʒ tu saɪnd baɪ ən ædˈvaɪzɚ/
dialogue.zh: 在第二頁，由顧問簽的字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine might be old, it's from spring.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn maɪt bi oʊld ɪts fɹʌm spɹɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我那張可能是舊的，春天簽的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They stop working by winter, sadly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ stɑːp ˈwɜɹkɪŋ baɪ ˈwɪnɾɚ ˈsædli/
dialogue.zh: 那種簽名到冬天就失效了，可惜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I need a fresh one from you?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ nid ə fɹæʃ wʌn fɹəm ju/
dialogue.zh: 所以我得請你重新簽一張？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I can sign it right now actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ kən saɪn ɪt raɪt naʊ ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 對，我現在就可以幫你簽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That helps so much, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt hɛlps soʊ mʌθ θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 那對我的幫助太大了，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happy to, now the big worry, money?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpi tə naʊ ðə bɪɡ ˈwɝi ˈmʌni/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，再來就是你最擔心的錢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fee, um, it's gone up, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fi ʌm ɪts ɡɑːn ʌp raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那個費用，嗯，漲價了，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It did, check the current fee on the site.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dɪd tʃɛk ðə ˈkɝənt fi ɑn ðə saɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是漲了，上網站確認現在的金額。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll confirm tonight, I hate surprises there.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl kənˈfɝm təˈnaɪt aɪ heɪt sɚˈpɹaɪzəz ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我今晚會確認，我討厭這種臨時加錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Does your school cover any of it?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt dʌz jɔɹ skul ˈkʌvɚ ˈɛni ʌv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。學校會幫你分擔一部分嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My school covers half, which is huge.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ skul ˈkʌvɚz hæf wɪtʃ ɪz hjudʒ/
dialogue.zh: 我學校負擔一半，那已經很多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you're set, most students stress that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jʊɹ sɛt moʊst ˈstudənts stɹɛs ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 那錢就沒問題了，多數學生都擔心這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: After I mail it, what happens next?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæftɚ aɪ meɪl ɪt wʌt ˈhæpənz nɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 我把申請寄出去之後，接下來會怎樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You get a receipt notice in a few weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɡɛt ə ɹɪˈsit ˈnoʊtɪs ɪn ə fju wikz/
dialogue.zh: 幾週後你會收到一張收據通知。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A receipt notice? Does that let me work?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɹɪˈsit ˈnoʊtɪs dʌz ðæt lɛt mi wɝk/
dialogue.zh: 收據通知？那張能讓我繼續工作嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The receipt keeps your work proof valid, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɹɪˈsit kips jɔɹ wɝk pruf ˈvælɪd jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 對，有收據你的工作證明就一直有效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh thank goodness, I feared a gap.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ θæŋk ˈɡʊdnəs aɪ fɪrd ə ɡæp/
dialogue.zh: 謝天謝地，我本來還怕會有空檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No gap if you file inside the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɡæp ɪf ju faɪl ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 只要在期間內送出，就不會有空檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Will the new card be mailed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd wɪl ðə nju kɑɹd bi meɪld/
dialogue.zh: 好。新的卡會用寄的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, to your home address, keep it current.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tə jɔɹ hoʊm əˈdrɛs kip ɪt ˈkɝənt/
dialogue.zh: 對，會寄到你家地址，請保持最新。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I just moved, so I have to update.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dʒʌst muːvd soʊ aɪ hæv tə əpˈdeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我剛搬家，所以我得更新地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Update it separately, don't wait on the card.
dialogue.phonetic: /əpˈdeɪt ɪt ˈsɛpɚɪtli doʊnt weɪt ɑn ðə kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 要另外單獨更新，別等卡片再來改。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, I almost mailed to a stale address.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt aɪ ˈɔlˌmoʊst meɪld tə ə steɪl əˈdrɛs/
dialogue.zh: 說得對，我差點寄到舊地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Common slip, the system won't catch that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑmən slɪp ðə ˈsɪstəm woʊnt kætʃ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 常有人這樣，系統不會幫你擋下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted. How long until the card arrives?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊɾɪd haʊ lɔŋ ənˈtɪl ðə kɑɹd əˈɹaɪvz/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。新卡大約多久會到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roughly three months, sometimes a bit less.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹʌfli θɹi mʌnθs ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz ə bɪt lɛs/
dialogue.zh: 大約三個月，有時會快一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three months, okay, I can plan around that.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹi mʌnθs oʊˈkeɪ aɪ kən plæn əˈɹaʊnd ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 三個月，好，我可以照這個安排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And keep a copy of everything you mail.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd kip ə ˈkɑpi ʌv ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ ju meɪl/
dialogue.zh: 還有，寄出去的東西都留一份複本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll scan them all before I go.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl skæn ðɛm ɔːl bɪˈfɔɹ aɪ ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我會出門前全部掃描存檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect habit, paper gets lost so easily.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ˈhæbɪt ˈpeɪpɚ ɡɛts lɔst soʊ ˈizəli/
dialogue.zh: 好習慣，紙本很容易弄丟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This eased my mind, honestly, a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs izd maɪ maɪnd ˈɑnəstli ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 這真的讓我安心了不少，老實說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's my job, come back if stuck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts maɪ dʒɑːb kʊm bæk ɪf stʌk/
dialogue.zh: 這本來就是我的工作，卡住就再回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will, thanks for the clear plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl θæŋks fɔɹ ðə klɪɹ plæn/
dialogue.zh: 我會的，謝謝你給我這麼清楚的一套計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, good luck with the renewal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm ɡʊd lʊk wɪð ðə ɹɪˈnjul/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，續辦一切順利。

script.youtube_title: 【許可快到期📄】「這樣我就放心了」教你辦工作許可續簽🪪🎓✈️｜聽完就能自己問ISO｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Work Permit Renewal
script.youtube_title_en: "Which Is a Relief" — Renewing a Work Permit at the International Office
script.youtube_description:
「這樣我就放心了」——工作許可快到期，該什麼時候申請、要帶什麼？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在國際學生辦公室。

你會聽到：開口問續辦、聽懂「到期前九十天」的申請窗口規定；照片規格、白底、摘眼鏡的完整說法；出境簽名過期怎麼辦、能不能請顧問當場重簽；還有收據通知能不能繼續工作、新卡多久寄到、地址要另外更新。

整段只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人真實語感：um、so、oh。聽完你就會用：check the date、inside the window、keep it current、I can plan around that。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Which is a relief" — your work permit is expiring, so when do you file and what do you bring? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice inside the international student office.

You will hear: asking to renew, learning the ninety-day window rule; the photo specs, white background, and no glasses; a faded travel signature and getting it re-signed on the spot; plus the receipt notice, working while waiting, the mailing time, and updating your address.

Everything stays in A2 words with real hedge words Americans use: um, so, oh. By the end you'll own check the date, inside the window, keep it current, and I can plan around that.

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧續辦工作許可英文｜九十天前申請・照片規格・出境簽名｜留學生必修流程｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
工作許可快到期，到底該幾天前申請？照片要幾張、什麼底色？出境簽名過期了又該怎麼辦？這些問題你問得出口嗎？

這一集帶大家走進國際學生辦公室，從詢問續辦期間、確認照片規格，一路聽到出境簽名、收據通知、寄卡時間與更新地址，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🪪 開場句：My work permit expires soon, I think.
📷 照片規格：Two, passport style, white background, recent.
✈️ 出境簽名：Then check your travel signature, please.
📮 收據通知：A receipt notice? Does that let me work?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、so、oh 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這趟續辦之行走一遍，下次自己走進辦公室，話就自己冒出來。

祝你續辦順利，工作不斷檔。
script.thumbnail_action: holding two small passport photos and a form
